goal: Increase exact trusted-IR support from Q1/Q6 to Q1/Q3/Q6/Q10 without raw SQL escape hatches.
selection_rule: Add the smallest independently checked relational feature that enables structurally different official queries; do not choose queries because of observed latency.

new_operator_fragment.semantic_rule: Limit changes row cardinality but not schema or field capabilities; Top-K adapters must place it after explicit Sort.

admitted_adapters.structure: three-table Join, filters, computed aggregate, aggregate-alias ordering, Top-10
four-table Join, temporal and categorical filters, computed aggregate, Top-20

explicitly_not_admitted.reason: Official semantics require a multi-predicate relationship that the single-key Join fragment cannot express without an unsafe approximation.

acceptance_gates: strict plan parsing and graph validation pass
policy evaluation returns REWRITE with pinned snapshots and source lineage
every governed candidate exactly matches official ordered columns and rows
candidate DuckDB physical-plan fingerprints remain distinct
every candidate produces a checked source-lineage certificate
the run is from a clean committed source tree
scientific_boundary: This is a semantic-coverage protocol. It contains no latency, optimizer accuracy, speedup, or workload-wide support claim.
